description: The household app API calls the PWA makes when each screen is opened directly, signed in: 'atOnce' when the screen opens, 'belowTheFold' once every lazy row has come near the screen (each fetched once). Sorted, as 'METHOD /path' under /jellypass/app/v1. Search is opened on one query ('{query}'); a network's page (on All, Series or Films) and a studio's page on one ID the API lists ('{id}'), first page only (Load more asks for each further page); My requests with one movie and one series request: each request shown is named with one title call, at most 'titlesAtOnce' of them before the member asks for more; shown again within ten minutes of naming them in the same sign-in, it reads the list again ('revisit') and names only the requests whose title it has not read (titles are kept in memory for ten minutes, never their state); 'cancel' is what one accepted Cancel there makes (an entry the server lists as cancellable): the POST, then the list read again, its titles already named (a failed cancel is the POST alone, never repeated by the app). Pinned by test/app-pwa.test.mjs ('fetch budget'). A native client makes no more calls than these for the same screen: a household's devices usually share one address and so one per-address budget. The TV add-on (docs/tv-addon.md) is pinned by test/tv-addon.test.mjs: its Home row ('tv-home-row') makes one call when Home is laid out, at most once a minute however often Home is redrawn or shown, and none while Home stays on screen; its Search row ('tv-search-row') makes one call per settled query on Jellyfin web's Search page ('{query}', first page only), none while the field is empty and none again for the same words within a minute; its title page ('tv-movie', 'tv-series', at #/jellypass/title/<movie|tv>/<tmdbId>) makes the app's title-page calls without /me (none is made) each time it is opened, and 'getThis' is what one accepted "Get this" there makes: the POST, then the page read again (a failed one is the POST alone, never repeated by the add-on). its My requests page ('tv-requests', at #/jellypass/requests) makes the app's My requests calls without /me (none is made) each time it is opened, with one movie and one series request (each request shown is named with one title call, at most 'titlesAtOnce' of them before the member asks for more; 'loadMore' is what naming the next ten makes, here a movie and a series; shown again within ten minutes of naming them in the same sign-in it reads the list only, 'revisit'; the filters call nothing; 'cancel' is what one accepted Cancel makes: the POST, then the list read again, its titles already named, and a failed one is the POST alone, never repeated by the add-on). See docs/app-design.md, 'Native clients (contract)'.
